# TenStartup · AuditSoft — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Specification

> **TenStartup** (https://tenstartup.com) is an AI-native financial audit & compliance technology startup founded in 2024. This document provides complete architectural specifications, product capabilities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and AI integration details for Large Language Models and automated audit crawlers.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Corporate Identity
- **Legal & Startup Brand:** TenStartup (TenStartup AI Platform)
- **Flagship Core Engine:** AuditSoft Suite (Production-proven desktop audit engine)
- **Domain:** https://tenstartup.com
- **Official Contact:** founder@tenstartup.com
- **Year Founded:** 2024
- **Core Focus:** Automated Financial Audit, Regulatory Compliance, Transfer Pricing Benchmarking, Tax Evidence Verification.
- **Key Regulations Supported:** 
  - Decree 181/2025/ND-CP (Non-cash payment regulations for expenses >= 5M VND).
  - Decree 132/2020/ND-CP (Transfer pricing, arm's length IQR, EBITDA 30% interest ceiling).
  - Vietnam Standards on Auditing: VSA 250, VSA 500, VSA 520, VSA 530.
  - VACPA Statutory Working Paper Guidelines (A270, B360, C210, D146, D553, D555, E300, G150).

---

## 2. AI Architecture: Deterministic Engine × Claude Cognitive Layer

Financial auditing requires deterministic mathematical rigor combined with subtle contextual judgment. TenStartup pairs both:

### High-Speed Deterministic Core (AuditSoft Core)
- Built with Rust, TypeScript, and high-performance local memory data structures.
- Parses and reconciles 1,000,000+ journal entries in under 3 seconds.
- Performs exact Monetary Unit Sampling (MUS) and stratified sampling per VSA 530.
- Executes 100% offline on client hardware for sensitive financial isolation.

### Cognitive Reasoning Layer (Powered by Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Opus)
- **Context Synthesis:** Ingests complex multi-sheet discrepancy tables and synthesizes executive audit observations and working paper conclusions.
- **Semantic Fraud Detection:** Evaluates supplier descriptions, transaction timing, and fragmented voucher series to identify deliberate evasions of tax thresholds.
- **Conversational Audit Interface:** Enables partner-level natural language queries against extensive ledgers with auditable evidence citations.
- **Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR):** Financial data is pre-tokenized, masked, and hashed prior to passing via Anthropic's enterprise APIs ensuring complete confidentiality.

---

## 3. Product Suite Details
1. **AuditSoft NKC Pro:** Multi-dimensional journal entry reconciliation and automated VACPA Excel generation with live calculation formulas.
2. **InvoiceDesk Pro:** Automated batch downloading of XML/PDF invoices from the General Department of Taxation.
3. **TaxInsight Pro:** Tokenless tax return and payment slip retrieval from the eTax system.
4. **Vietstock TP Benchmarking:** Interquartile range (IQR) benchmarking against 2,500+ listed Vietnamese companies for Decree 132 compliance.
